title: LaNorme configuration
description: The [tool.lanorme] table in pyproject.toml, or top-level keys in a standalone lanorme.toml.

select.description: Run only these rule codes or categories. A category is the part of a code before the dash: `CMT` covers every comment rule; `ALL` selects everything.

ignore.description: Skip these rule codes or categories everywhere.

exclude.description: File-path globs to skip entirely; matched files are never walked. These directories are always skipped, whatever this key says: `.git`, `.mypy_cache`, `.pytest_cache`, `.ruff_cache`, `.venv`, `__pycache__`, `build`, `dist`, `node_modules`, `venv`.

per-file-ignores.description: Suppress specific rule codes or categories for files matching a glob.

promote.description: Rule codes or categories (or `ALL`) whose advisory warnings become build-failing errors. Promotion runs after `ignore`, `per-file-ignores` and `# noqa`, so a suppressed warning is never promoted.

extends.description: Adopt one or more profiles -- a bundled name (`strict`, `hexagonal`, `clean`, `layered`) or a path to a local `.toml`. Profiles merge left to right, then your own keys merge on top, so local always wins.

baseline.description: Path to a baseline file. Findings recorded by `lanorme baseline write` are suppressed, so only new findings report. See the [adoption tutorial](../tutorials/adopt-on-existing-codebase.md).

source_root.description: The top-level package directory when ports, adapters and layers live under a nested package; the architecture checks interpret their paths relative to it, `AUTHN-001` finds the `api/` layer under it, and `TESTFILE-001` its production directories.

plugins.description: Extra check modules to import so they self-register, beyond the built-ins and entry-point plugins.

root.description: In a nested config file, stop inheriting from the config files above it, so the subtree stands alone. See [per-directory config](#per-directory-config).
